additional_info.subject: ID0443587-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003305] Connector 3 faulted CRM:02684000480
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin, good afternoon.
I am taking this ticket over to support you on solving this issue.
I already analysed on the time you provided and we have a communication issue between our charger and the charging controller.
We have a hotfix available for this specific issue right now, which strengthens the communication mitigating these failures. The update takes around 15-20mins.
To apply this hotfix, I need the charger to be 100% free. If you are able to deactivate the outlets remotely, please do it when it's fully free. Otherwise I will try to proactively check it myself.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
